title: Mit Bestand Zwischenbericht Compiling
summary: Fixed mit-bestand Zwischenbericht LaTeX compilation. Corrected inverted optional-argument handling in `\maketableofcontents` (`\IfNoValueF` → `\IfValueTF`). Hardened TOC register aux handling to store and reload plain section titles instead of KOMA `\Sectionformat` fragments that broke multi-pass Tectonic builds with “Missing number”. Verified `@semio-tech/mit-bestand-bericht:build` produces `zwischenbericht.pdf` and `zwischenbericht-dark.pdf`, and `print:build` succeeds for all templates.
